maria: Deploybot kicked off release pipeline for tag v2.14.0 to staging — commit de4f1a2. Change window 11:00-13:00 PST. build -> lint -> tests. @kevin @sasha

deploybot: [pipeline] started: build (staging) — commit de4f1a2 — triggered by maria

deploybot: [pipeline] build finished — SUCCESS — artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/de4f1a2.tar.gz

deploybot: [pipeline] lint started

ci-bot: lint ERROR in pkg/optimizer/batcher.go:78: exportCommentedCode — trailing commented code block
```
pkg/optimizer/batcher.go:78: // TODO: remove hardcoded batch size 16
```

sasha: ugh lint failed, new linter rule caught that TODO. small fix though.

maria: Is lint failure a blocker for canary at 11:15?

kevin: Don't promote a lint-failing build. Options: quick patch + rerun, pin canary to v2.13.9, or abort and hotfix. Prefer quick patch if <5m.

sasha: I'll push a one-line cleanup now and kick tests.

sasha: PR posted fixes/lint/remove-batch-todo — running unit tests.

deploybot: [pipeline] tests started

```
--- FAIL: TestCacheEviction (0.12s)
    cache_test.go:45: expected eviction count 2, got 3
```

kevin: That test flakes sometimes on staging. Can we rerun only tests stage?

maria: rerun allowed. triggering tests-only retry.

deploybot: [pipeline] tests started (retry #1)

deploybot: [pipeline] tests finished — SUCCESS

maria: Tests green on retry. Given lint fix + passing tests, proceed with canary but shortened window: 30m. @kevin please add alerts for canary route 5xx > 1% (5m) and p95 > 200ms (5m).

kevin: Alert rules created, added runbook link.

maria: Rolling canary -> v2.14.0-canary1 to canary-staging. Deploybot will post status.

deploybot: [deploy] canary rollout started -> env: canary-staging -> image: de4f1a2 -> tag: v2.14.0-canary1

sasha: Dashboards monitoring :eyes:

deploybot: [deploy] canary rollout finished — 3 instances updated — no immediate errors

maria: Keeping canary 30m. If no alerts, schedule prod push at 12:00 in change window. Release notes will mention optimizer lint fix and batching improvements.

kevin: If alerts trigger, rollback to v2.13.9 and I'll set routing weight to 0%.

sasha: Drafting release notes: "Fix: removed commented hardcoded batch hint; Stability: minor test-flake mitigation." Will link PRs.

maria: Updating release checklist and closing thread. :white_check_mark:
